title: CONTRACT_REGISTRY
note: Explicit version selection. A runtime that loads 'the latest contract' cannot replay an older result, and keeping V1 on disk is worthless if nothing can select it. Every round names the contract version it runs under; ignition verifies the file on disk hashes to the value recorded here and REFUSES on mismatch, missing, or unknown.
